context.baseline_scope: One submission from seeds, no experiments; expected win rate with uniform MAP tie breaking on scored items, equal weight per headline tier.
context.exposure: Rule catalogs are public and include classes used in experiments while this benchmark was developed. Sealed items hide seed pairs, not the rule universe. This benchmark does not establish contamination-free reasoning.
context.prior: T1-T4 share the 3-piece catalog prior because their tier is not revealed; T5 and T6 use their registered tier classes.
